title: LIVECULTUREBENCH: a Multi-Agent, Multi-Cultural Benchmark for Large Language Models in Dynamic Social Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of LLM-based agents to adhere to culture-specific social norms (sourced from CultureBank) when role-playing characters from diverse nationalities (e.g., British, Chinese, Vietnamese, Greek, Filipino) in a dynamic social simulation.

Analyzing performance disparities in norm adherence and task completion between agents representing Western/English-speaking cultures (e.g., British, German, Australian) and those from underrepresented or non-Western cultures (e.g., Vietnamese, Filipino, Scottish).
